name: wafc-analysis-workstation
description: Analysis Workstation for trusted WA Evidence Bag intake and case review

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @wafc/domain build && pnpm --filter @wafc/evidence-repository build && pnpm --filter @wafc/workstation-core build
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/usb-provisioner/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/usb-provisioner/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --manifest-path ../tools/verify-cli/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path ../tools/verify-cli/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:rust && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
